bio: Pinpointing the Onyx experience can be a challenging task, as this is a place that undergoes constant evolution in the pursuit of self-improvement. What can be said, is that you will be part of a truly immersive experience, as you arrive at the same time as your fellow guests, ready to share a memorable evening together. The communal experience is a stimulating, sensory and provocative one, that uses a multi-course tasting menu to showcase the development of food in the past, present and future. Without giving too much away, your night here will include light, sound, capes and contemplation!...
